title: A Sharp Mass Threshold for Boundedness in a Critical Quasilinear Chemotaxis Model With Indirect Signal Production: The Radially Symmetric Case
summary: A critical quasilinear chemotaxis model with indirect signal production in space dimensions higher than two is studied under radial symmetry. Exploiting the variational structure of the system, the existence of a sharp mass threshold M\textsubscr{c} > 0 is established: all solutions with mass below M\textsubscr{c} are global and bounded, while those with mass above M\textsubscr{c} and sufficiently negative energy are global but blow up in infinite time.
